items.t: Cottonwood, Maple Ridge: 55 houses sold at a median of $1,195,000, with the middle half between $1,079,500 and $1,346,000. The median house took 29 days to sell and closed at 97.1% of list.

75 townhomes sold in Cottonwood, Maple Ridge at a median of $750,000 (middle half $716,200 to $830,500). A typical townhome in Cottonwood, Maple Ridge spent 27 days on the market and closed at 97.9% of the asking price.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Cottonwood compares with the rest of Maple Ridge

items.t: Houses in Cottonwood have the 5th highest median of 9 Maple Ridge sub-areas, $1,195,000. Southwest Maple Ridge is lowest at $1,039,000 and Silver Valley highest at $1,421,500. East Central ($1,100,000) sits just below and Albion ($1,244,000) sits just above.

Of 8 Maple Ridge sub-areas with 5 or more townhome sales, Cottonwood ranks third highest at $750,000; the range is $610,000 (Southwest Maple Ridge) to $862,000 (Thornhill). Albion ($745,000) sits just below and Silver Valley ($805,000) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, townhomes are the newest homes selling in Cottonwood, Maple Ridge (median 2015) and houses the oldest (median 2002), a gap of 13 years.
